name: wake-no-replug
summary: EXPERIMENTAL: after a deep-standby wake, re-enable the input port without the hot-plug pulse (emulated unplug: PC re-detects the monitor, other monitors blank)
status: experimental, hardware test pending (v1, which skipped the whole port update, removed the disconnect but left the port without signal)

edits.asm: sub_239479 entry (addi r1,-0xc + first byte of sw 8(r1),r9) -> j wnr (0x23947D unused)

notes: Deep-standby wake (PM 0x3AA bits 4:2 == 1) within the first 5 s: mailbox 0x20 sub 14 (hot-plug pulse request, sub_239479 via sub_23EE83) is not sent; the port configuration and enable (0x60 sub 2, 0x20 sub 0) are. Power-key and mains starts, and later changes, take the vendor path. Uses the cave 0x203FB8 that the current diag-log also uses: build it without diag-log.
